timeline.title: Co-Founder & Chief Technology Officer (CTO) – Neuva Innovations LLP

Developed an internal Expense and Fund Management web application for Kavone using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and AWS services. Worked with AWS Lambda, S3, SQS, and DynamoDB to build cloud-based web applications.

Actively involved in projects, coding communities, and collaborative learning experiences to build strong technical and problem-solving skills.

Successfully organized technical events and mentored junior students in their career development.
